title: Cuba: six dated statements, from Senate to State Department
kicker: Cuba · Senate record and Secretary of State record
dek: Six dated statements show what Marco Rubio said as a senator and later as Secretary of State. The related Senate roll calls below are displayed as recorded casts, not as a conclusion about those statements.

key_votes.text: on an amendment concerning detainee transfers from the U.S. naval station at Guantanamo Bay, Cuba.
on another amendment concerning detainee transfers from the U.S. naval station at Guantanamo Bay, Cuba.

statements.quote: It is Cuba, a nation that is a global sponsor of terrorism, because they harbor fugitives from American justice, because they helped North Korea evade U.N. sanctions openly and nothing happened. Now the State Department is thinking about removing them from the list of sponsors of terrorism--one concession after another.
we should not abandon the cause of freedom in our own hemisphere and allow cruel and immoral dictatorships in Cuba and Venezuela to be absolved of their crimes
statements.highlight: should not abandon the cause of freedom

statements.quote: Jose could stay in Cuba, a place that, to this day, is still ruled by a despotic regime where your talent and work can take you only as far as unelected dictators say you can go
statements.highlight: still ruled by a despotic regime

statements.venue: Secretary of State · Lech Walesa Solidarity Prize ceremony

statements.quote: The Trump Administration is restoring a tough Cuba policy that protects America and helps the Cuban people.

statements.venue: Secretary of State · Fox News Channel interview
statements.quote: Cuba is two things right now. Number one, it’s a failed state. It has really no real economy, so its people are living in dire misery and have no political freedoms either. And the second is it’s a host nation for adversaries and competitors.
statements.highlight: it’s a host nation for adversaries and competitors
